title: Magento audit: 40-minute checklist for an inherited store
lede: A 22-person agency just took over a Magento 2.3 store. The previous dev is unreachable. Here is the 40-minute audit we run before changing a single line.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen of an audit checklist, CLI run-sheet, ER blueprint, brass plate, stopwatch, ruler, wax seal.
